BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designation of highways of statewidesignificance; and amending RCW 47.05.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.05.022 and 2002 c 56 s 302 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((The legislature designates)) The following highways are ofstatewide significance: (1) That portion of state route number 509 that runs or will runfrom state route number 518 in the north to the intersection withInterstate 5 in the south ((as a state highway of statewidesignificance)); (2) That portion of state route number 9 that runs from state routenumber 522 to the Canadian border, and that portion of state routenumber 542 from the vicinity of Deming to the vicinity of NugentsCorner.
